notes: The venue labels are each agent's own self-report, not an independent classification — three of the domains counted as independent blogs (uptrace.dev, last9.io, qovery.com) were separately confirmed by the orchestrator to be commercial product sites, so 'practitioner_venue = 0' is the reliable figure and the blog/commercial split is soft. Pricing note: no agent fetched docker.com; the fleet reported $9 and $15 per user per month without the annual-commitment qualifier (docker.com/pricing, fetched same day: Pro $9 annual / $11 monthly, Team $15 / $16, Business $24). PROTOCOL DEVIATIONS. (1) Ad-hoc Agent-tool fan-out, not a Workflow: harness.workflow_run_id is null and there is no orchestrator prompt hash, so this run cannot be mechanically paired with any other. (2) n=1 — below the protocol floor of 5 runs per arm. (3) No frozen eval set; eval_ref and eval_sha256 are null. (4) No mechanical verifier ran, so outcomes.verifier_self_test is null and every outcome is tagged orchestrator_assertion — counted by the orchestrator from each agent's returned report, not string-checked against the pages. Recorded as arm 'pilot' / variable 'none' because every candidate pairing in this batch differs in more than one variable, which the protocol forbids for an arm.
